company.name: Spark Influencer Marketing Power House
company.shortDescription: Spark creates and manages advertising campaigns through social networks of digital influencers using it proprietary platform.
company.description:
Since 2014, we create and manage activation projects brands through  digital influencers and personalities social networks, supported by a proprietary technology platform that applies intelligence at all stages of the process of a campaign. 

Our work is based on three pillars: technology, creativity and excellence in execution. 

We believe in combining these 3 factors to deliver the best solutions in content marketing and digital influence campaigns. We are part of Fluvip, the largest category group in the world, with presence in 8 countries and 15 cities across the Americas and Europe. The group pioneered the segment's professionalis in Latin America, with the main driver being the development of proprietary technologies applied to the segment of content marketing and digital influence. In Brazil, we are present in 6 cities: São Paulo, Brasília, Curitiba, Porto Alegre, Manaus and Vitória.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $1,505,117, or 31.99% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,105,803 to $18,163,647, a 16.43x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 57 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 56 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
